Before you check out

Is it the right size?

Check the dimensions on the product page against your space: beam span, corbel depth, shutter height. Not sure? Send us your measurements.

Which material?

Timberthane faux wood gives you the look of wood, maintenance-free. AmeriCraft is stain-grade real wood. Interior or exterior, tell us where it's going and we'll steer you right.

When will it ship?

Heritage Series beams ship in 24-72 hours. Items marked "Free Shipping" ship free to the lower 48 states.

Can I return it?

Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a partial refund (20% processing fee; you cover return shipping). Made-to-order items can't be returned.

How does it install?

Product pages list the specs, and many include an install guide. Read it before you order so you know what the job takes.
